caption: The drawing depicts a figure dressed in a voluminous garment consisting of multiple layers and intricate details. The main outer garment is a deep purple, full-length cloak or mantle that covers the figure from head to toe, including the head which is covered by a hood adorned with a purple trim and a small, light-colored fringe. The cloak features a prominent row of gathered or ruched fabric running along the back and continuing down the side, as well as ruffled and scalloped edging in both purple and a light beige or cream color. Underneath the cloak and partially visible at the bottom, there is a cream or light beige skirt, organized in horizontal tiers with ruffled edges. Several decorative bows in purple and mustard yellow are placed along the side of the skirt, each accented with a small circular ornament at the center. The overall composition is centered, with the figure facing away from the viewer, and there is no background or additional objects in the drawing. The image is rendered in soft, blended tones with careful shading to suggest folds and texture in the fabric.
title: Dress
